hypothesis: Initializing candidate encoding from bounded left context improves source-form ranking relative to independently encoded C2 without increasing parameter count or training budget.
single_change: Reuse C2 embedding, single-layer GRU, seven features and scorer with identical parameter names/shapes/initial weights. Candidate GRU h0 is the encoded left context, computed once and shared across candidates. Reading encoding remains independent. Empty context produces zero h0 and matches C2. No vocabulary, loss, gate or pretraining change.

training.source_mix: Frozen first 25000 Wikipedia plus 25000 Aozora research examples from data-growth-v2
training.loss: Same C2 masked listwise cross-entropy, label smoothing 0.05
training.device: CUDA, existing pinned environment; four host threads, one interop thread

evaluation.models: Frozen initial #29 plus all six fits; no best-seed selection
evaluation.start: Only after all six fits terminate successfully and immutable model receipts are committed/bound
populations: predeclared 53 groups / 212 rows with both forms in Top6
evaluation.shuffle: Within main/non-main roles and context-length buckets [8,15], [16,31], [32,64], sort target IDs by canonical SHA-256([20261105,'shuffle',stable_id]) and cyclically shift by one. Singleton strata remain unchanged and are counted. One permutation only, fixed before predictions.
evaluation.gate: Existing research #29 margin >1.7, fixed as a reference only. No threshold fitting or calibration on this cohort.
evaluation.metrics: Source-exact accuracy, R/H/wrong-to-wrong, correction failures, application and error application, precision/recall, baseline gain, candidate/model failures, all with unchanged denominators. Report missing-candidate and rank-failure counts separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Wilson and exact harm intervals under row assumptions, plus paired component bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 20261105). Main uses source components; contrasts union source components and reading-contrast groups. These are exploratory source-form intervals, not independent Gold/safety certification.
evaluation.primary_comparisons: Three paired context_initialized-minus-c2 intact/ungated main comparisons, one per seed; report all three and the mean point difference. No post-hoc threshold/seed/hyperparameter search.
evaluation.advance_rule: Advance the conditioned structure only if all three primary point differences are nonnegative, their mean is positive, every primary paired 95% lower bound is above zero, and supported-contrast source agreement improves for at least two seeds. Otherwise retain C2 for the next separately preregistered pretraining comparison. This is a research structure decision, not production adoption.

cpu_benchmark: Export the prespecified 20260814 fit of each architecture to research FP32 ONNX. Verify CPU parity over all 1215 rows, including alternate/empty contexts. Windows CPU only, GPU disabled, batch one, ORT intra/inter-op one thread, 200 warmups then 10000 runs per model. Report p50/p95/p99/max and failures; p95<=2ms and p99<=5ms remain unchanged.
quality_limits: Original-source agreement is not IME-intent Gold. KWDLC is evaluation-only. 991 main rows cannot establish the 0.25% harm limit even with zero observed harms under the independent-row exact interval, and source/label uncertainty remains. No Gate A/B or release approval is implied.
